mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE year_list AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 4 AS `key` UNION ALL SELECT `key` + 1 FROM year_list WHERE `key` + 1 <= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ), proc_data AS ( SELECT YEAR(BUY_TIME) AS `key`, dept_id, COALESCE(SUM(`COUNT`), 0) AS value FROM XFPT_PROC_SUMMARY WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND del_flag = '0' AND BUY_TIME >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4, 1) AND BUY_TIME < MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()) + 1, 1) GROUP BY dept_id, YEAR(BUY_TIME) ) SELECT yl.`key`, pd.dept_id, COALESCE(pd.value, 0) AS value FROM year_list yl LEFT JOIN proc_data pd ON yl.`key` = pd.`key` ORDER BY yl.`key` DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE year_list AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 4 AS `key` UNION ALL SELECT `key` + 1 FROM year_list WHERE `key` + 1 <= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ), proc_data AS ( SELECT YEAR(BUY_TIME) AS `key`, dept_id, COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) AS value FROM XFPT_PROC_SUMMARY WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND del_flag = '0' AND BUY_TIME >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4, 1) AND BUY_TIME < MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()) + 1, 1) GROUP BY dept_id, YEAR(BUY_TIME) ) SELECT yl.`key`, pd.dept_id, COALESCE(pd.value, 0) AS value FROM year_list yl LEFT JOIN proc_data pd ON yl.`key` = pd.`key` ORDER BY yl.`key` DESC
